[[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] | after_party = No overall control }} {{Main|Oxford City Council elections}} The '''2026 Oxford City Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect 24 of 48 members of [[Oxford City Council]] in [[Oxfordshire]], [[England]].{{Cite web|title=Local elections in Oxford will go ahead as planned, Government confirms|url=https://www.oxfordmail.co.uk/news/25788195.oxford-local-elections-will-go-ahead-may-planned/|website=Oxford Mail|date=2026-01-22|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}} Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this was the final election to Oxford City Council before it will be abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]]. Elections to the successor authority are due to take place in 2027. ==Summary== ===Background=== In [[2024 Oxford City Council election|2024]], the council remained under [[no overall control]] with the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] the largest party.{{Cite web|title=Full Oxford Local Election results as Independents gain seats|url=https://www.oxfordmail.co.uk/news/24298939.oxford-city-council-local-election-2024-results-full/|website=Oxford Mail|date=2024-05-03|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}} The council election was not delayed after a debate.{{Cite web|title=Local election delay: Criticism of 'disgraceful' Oxford response|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3wznwpzlepo|website=BBC News|date=2026-01-16|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}} === Council composition === {| class="wikitable" |- ! colspan="3" | After 2024 election ! colspan="3" | Before 2026 election |- ! colspan="2" | Party !
